title: Thai Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful Thai-inspired noodle soup made with tender chicken, soft noodles, and a variety of aromatic spices.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Cook the soft noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the Thai red curry paste over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, and cooked noodles to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the fresh Thai basil and serve hot with lime wedges on the side.
